text_block_list.text:
The first three years walked alongside 
Hishi Akebono came to a close.

However, the road ahead still continues. 
One day, as I was pondering the future...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Could you help me out with an UmaSta Live 
again sometime~?
choice_data_list: Sure, but why so suddenly again?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
After we greeted everyone once before, 
they all got interested in the races, 
didn't they~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So many people came out to watch, and 
everyone was cheering their hearts out for 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Things just settled down, so I wanted to 
take the chance to properly say thank you 
to everyone~.

And so, I ended up helping out with the 
livestream once again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Every day is buono! Big and delicious is 
the way to be♪ I'm Hishi Akebono~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Today, someone you all know well, my 
Trainer, has come to help out once again~.

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, it's the Trainer!" "Good job in the 
race!" "I saw you at the track!"

Compared to before, comments brimming with 
a certain warmth and familiarity came 
scrolling by at high speed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. All right, let's start with today's 
recipe! Today, we're making an easy 
homemade baumkuchen ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show you a recipe you can easily 
make at home with a frying pan~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
First, melt the butter in the microwave. 
While that's happening, let's mix the 
eggs, sugar, and honey~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Once it's all mixed, we add the flour. 
Trainer, get the cake flour and baking 
powder ready~!

And just like that, Hishi Akebono's 
Umastagram Live proceeded smoothly...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Pour the batter into the frying pan... Put 
the foil core in the middle, and roll it 
right up~! Round and round we go!

The dough rolls up smoothly. A sweet, 
aromatic scent spreads throughout the 
kitchen—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All finished~! It's a super buono 
baumkuchen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And so! Let's dig right in, Trainer☆

The sliced baumkuchen had cooled down 
slightly and was pleasantly warm.

Taking a single bite... a gentle sweetness 
slowly spread through the fluffy pastry.

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer sure eats with gusto~" "That's a 
good Trainer right there."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. That's right, my Trainer's my pride 
and joy♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And so, the reason I asked you to come 
today, Trainer, was because I wanted to 
say thank you to everyone~.

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"A thank-you?" "Thank you for what?" "Did 
we do something?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember when I introduced you on 
Umastagram Live, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even when it had nothing to do with 
cooking, everyone cheered us on with big 
smiles, right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Some people got interested and actually 
came to the racetrack, and that just made 
me super happy."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The races settled down for a bit the other 
day. I made so many fun and happy 
memories.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
This is all thanks to everyone cheering 
for me with big smiles, right~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And so, I just wanted to say thank you. 
Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Bono-chan...!" "What a good girl..." 
"Thank you so much too~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
From now on too, whether it's cooking or 
racing, we plan on doing our best in our 
own special way~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So everyone, please keep cheering for me 
and Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow, the day after, and always, 
always, for years and years to come, take 
good care of me, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Of course." "Do your best for a long time 
to come." "Ah, that's why it's a 
baumkuchen!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Oops, I've been found out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...The reason I made baumkuchen today was 
because I wanted to make a little wish~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wished that together, we can keep piling 
up happiness and make it grow bigger and 
bigger.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It's a little embarrassing when you 
find out, huh.

That day's Umastagram stream came to an 
end amidst a greater flurry of comments 
and stamps than ever.
